# Database primitives blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The Database primitives blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## updated-at

Keeps an updated_at column current on every update.

- Title: Update timestamps
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/updated-at
- Client: `better-supabase/blocks/updated-at`
- Modes: `managed`

## realtime-tables

Broadcasts a change signal (no row data) once per statement on bsb:t:<schema>.<table>[:<tenant>], or bsb:t:<schema>.<table>:u:<user> for realtime.users tables, for live queries.

- Title: Realtime table changes
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/realtime-tables
- Modes: `managed`
- Works with: `memberships`

## jsonb-schemas

pg_jsonschema check constraints for jsonb columns with a `schema` in the `json` config, so the database enforces the same shape as the types. A trigger reports what failed through jsonschema_validation_errors, which the client maps to a validation error.

- Title: JSON Schema checks for jsonb
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/jsonb-schemas
- Modes: `managed`

## pgtap

tests.create_user, tests.authenticate_as and catalog checks (every_table_has_rls, policies_use, no_anon_policies, every_table_audited, partitions_have_rls) for `supabase test db`. Written to supabase/tests, never to your schema.

- Title: pgTAP helpers
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/pgtap
- Modes: `managed`

## read-sets

One `stable` function per `defineReadSet` in `readSets`, so `db.$many(readSet, params)` is a single GET.

- Title: Read sets
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/read-sets
- Modes: `managed`

## numbering

Gapless numbers per tenant, entity and period. next_number locks the row in the caller's transaction, and a trigger fills the document column so a separate round trip cannot open a gap.

- Title: Number sequences
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/numbering
- Client: `numberingBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/numbering`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `invoices`, `legal-entities`, `imports`
- Events (`NumberingEvents`): `number.assigned`

## imports

Import runs and the external record map. import_upsert_batch writes items through the targets blocks and the app register, skips equal content, reports rows a user changed since the last import and marks missing keys on full runs. The dry run, parsing and mapping live in TypeScript.

- Title: Imports
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/imports
- Client: `importsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/imports`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `queue`
- Works with: `attachments`, `contacts`, `invoices`, `ledger`, `outbox`, `search`
- Events (`ImportsEvents`): `import.completed`, `import.entity_completed`, `import.failed`

## rank

Fractional rank keys: rank_between, move() for every config.recordTypes entry with a rank column (through the caller's policies and any state-machine trigger), and a rebalance job.

- Title: Rank
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/rank
- Client: `rankBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/rank`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `queue`

## versions

Numbered snapshots of a subject's content: manual, debounced auto and frozen snapshots, restore through columns or an apply function, and retention.

- Title: Versions
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/versions
- Client: `versionsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/versions`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `share-links`, `ai-files`
- Entities: `version`
- Tables: `versions`
- Permission keys: `versions.read`, `versions.create`, `versions.restore`, `versions.manage`
- Events (`VersionsEvents`): `version.created`, `version.deleted`, `version.restored`

## trash

Soft delete through each subject's deletedAt column: trash with children in one batch, restore with unique checks, a list per organization, and purge after a retention period, skipped for subjects under a legal hold.

- Title: Trash
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/trash
- Client: `trashBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/trash`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `housekeeping`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `data-lifecycle`, `housekeeping`, `bulk-actions`
- Events (`TrashEvents`): `subject.purged`, `subject.restored`, `subject.trashed`

## field-history

The old and new value of chosen columns of any registered record on every update, who changed it and when, read per record and field.

- Title: Field history
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/field-history
- Client: `fieldHistoryBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/field-history`
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `data-lifecycle`

## field-encryption

Encrypts app table columns and custom field values at rest with a data key per tenant, user or app, kept in Supabase Vault as bs:field-key:<owner>. Only security definer read paths that check the caller's scope decrypt; a lookup column keeps an HMAC of the value under the owner's lookup key for equality searches; drop_field_key deletes both keys so the values can no longer be read or found. Members read which of their owners have keys, with the key dates and what they encrypt, through field_key_status(), and rotate_field_key replaces a data key and encrypts its values again.

- Title: Field encryption
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/field-encryption
- Client: `fieldEncryptionBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/field-encryption`
- Modes: `managed`
- Events (`FieldEncryptionEvents`): `field_key.dropped`, `field_key.rotated`

## rls-guard

An event trigger that enables row level security on every table created outside the Supabase-managed schemas, so a new table is never readable through the Data API before it has policies. Install it as postgres: supautils lets that role create event triggers.

- Title: RLS on every new table
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/rls-guard
- Modes: `managed`
